# Advisor Requirements Checklist: Codex Advisor

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the privacy, failure-path and verdict requirements for the Codex advisor
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Privacy and Access

- [ ] CHK001 Is what leaves the machine on each call (prompt, files Codex reads) stated as a requirement and not only as an assumption? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "env or secret files" defined well enough that a reviewer can tell which files the prompt must forbid? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the off switch requirement (`mode: off`) consistent between FR-010, FR-016 and User Story 4? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "read-only sandbox, no write or bypass flag" stated so that a test can check the exact command? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec say that Codex is never used to build or fix, in every place the advisor is described (README, three skills)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §FR-016]

## Failure Paths

- [ ] CHK006 Are all failure classes named with their one-line result: codex missing, codex error, empty answer, malformed answer, missing verdict, timeout, bad mode file? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-010, §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the exit status for each failure class specified (success for "no advisor", non-success for BLOCKED)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "the flow runs as before this feature" defined precisely enough to test, including the `/advisor` step? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the time limit requirement stated as a measured value or as a placeholder with a named owner (Plan phase)? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec say what the orchestrator does after the user answers "continue" on a BLOCKED from a codex error: skip the point, or retry? [Gap, Spec §User Story 2 scenario 2]

## Verdict and Record

- [ ] CHK011 Are the three verdicts and their orchestrator actions each defined exactly once, without conflict between FR-005, FR-006 and User Story 1? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "two rounds at most" defined per point and per session, so a second REVISE after a plan change is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the hashed input for each point stated so that two implementers would hash the same bytes (plan file only, or spec and tasks too)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the record format specified enough for the stale check to find "the latest record for that point"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 Is a finding's required shape (claim, evidence, location, severity) consistent between FR-003 and Key Entities? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Is "zero findings is valid" reconciled with REVISE: can REVISE carry zero findings, and what happens then? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-003]

## Scope and Docs

- [ ] CHK017 Is the Quick lane exclusion stated in the requirements and not only in a user story? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the exact doc locations to change listed so Close can check drift? [Traceability, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the `st-init` question requirement consistent with how st-init asks its other one-question steps? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
